$comment: Educational catalog of higher-tier implementations (SPEC §12). Shaped, to be curated: tier → features, each with description, use case, a hook naming the tenant-computed value that makes it concrete, and a docs link. Never rendered as an upsell or a lock.

featureShape.name: Feature name
featureShape.description: What it does, in plain language.
featureShape.useCase: When a tenant would want it.
featureShape.tenantValueHook: snapshot or checkpoint field that makes this concrete for THIS tenant (e.g. counts.notChallenged)
